flags.why: The dessert sense is an everyday regional usage, not rare, as documented in [Huế food reporting](https://tuoitre.vn/dulichtphcm/an-gi/thom-ngon-chen-dau-hu-xu-hue-c12a43355.html).

This dessert name is characteristic of Central Vietnamese, particularly Huế, and needs a regional label ([source](https://khamphahue.com.vn/en-us/Tourism/Detail/tid/Tofu-Pudding-in-Hue.html/pid/15922/cid/493)).
The example defines nhũ hương instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Người thợ dùng nhũ hương để làm vecni. = The craftsman uses mastic to make varnish.

flags.why: Thân sĩ does not have a separate derogatory meaning of someone concerned only with literary pursuits ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/th%C3%A2n_s%C4%A9)).
Literal thổ huyết is a formal or literary expression for vomiting blood, rather than ordinary conversational wording ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/tho-huyet-eQdhTmvwFslQM.html)).
